rule_source: SRD 5.2 Feats: Magic Initiate; PHB 2024 Guide
choices: Druidcraft, Mending, Speak with Animals using WIS; one free long-rest cast of Speak with Animals, and eligible slots where available

cost: Ordinary, ritual or feat-free casting independently
choices: No Beast type in current roster: ordinary familiar is Fey, steed is Celestial/Fey/Fiend, and Wild Shape retains Humanoid type

trigger: Observable weather, plant bloom, small sensory flourish, candle/torch/campfire
choices: Map has no functional weather, plant, candle, torch, campfire or deception-by-flourish subsystem. Burning a dropped weapon is a different effect.

trigger: Touch an item with a single short repairable break or tear
cost: Ten rounds with continual Magic actions and concentration; V, S, lodestones
choices: Select touchable recoverable wooden fracture. Repeat Magic action on ten consecutive own turns while concentrating. Dents, burned pieces and destroyed metal are ineligible; earlier wear remains after repair. Visible casting offers Counterspell before repair.

trigger: Trading or end of Long Rest
choices: Smith background tool plus three fixed Crafter tools. Arena contains no purchases or Long Rest; construction exploits stay outside.

trigger: Finishing a Short/Long Rest with willing creatures listening
choices: The Bard knows lute, bagpipes, drum, flute, horn, lyre and viol. No pre-combat listener or rest phase is staged.
Three selected bonus proficiencies per build; each is distinct from class and background skills

rule_source: SRD 5.2 Wizard Spellbook, Ritual Adept and Evocation Savant
cost: Two spellbook choices per additional level plus fixed Evocation Savant grants at 3/5
choices: Six, eight, twelve, fourteen and seventeen entries at successive levels; Find Familiar is book-only and exceeds the duel horizon
